units.rawText: So you've come to the roof for a walk as well, comrade? Heh... I was just thinking about the past.

spans.text: So you've come to the roof for a walk as well, comrade? Heh... I was just thinking about the past.

units.rawText: It was when I was building the Future Gadgets Lab and only Daru and Mayuri were around. Now, I have so many friends by my side...  It's strange isn't it?
units.displayText: It was when I was building the Future Gadgets Lab and only Daru and Mayuri were around. Now, I have so many friends by my side...  It's strange isn't it?

units.rawText: It's thanks to them that all the effort I've put in for so long feels like it's paid off. You think the same way too, right?
